mapper.insert: insert into basket_point_adjustment (season_id, stage_id, group_id, team_id, discipline_id, adjustment_points, adjustment_reason, idempotency_key, operator_id, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{seasonId}, #{stageId}, #{groupId}, #{teamId}, #{disciplineId}, #{adjustmentPoints}, #{adjustmentReason}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operatorId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, season_id as seasonId, stage_id as stageId, group_id as groupId, team_id as teamId, discipline_id as disciplineId, adjustment_points as adjustmentPoints, adjustment_reason as adjustmentReason, idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, operator_id as operatorId, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_point_adjustment where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
